gates.gate1_status: not_requested (no promotion sought in this experiment)
gates.gate2_status: not yet run; the independent A/B happens after training and is recorded in the E2 training receipt

hardware_identity.note: 8 GB RTX 5050 laptop; no GPU was used in the pretrain stages (authoring, tracing, judging, distilling)

limitations: A pass rate on these authored cases measures THIS case set only; it is not a quality claim about any model.
Implementation success is not model-quality success.
The final split was never opened; no measurement exists for it.
The teacher is behavioural-only: no routers, experts or internal state were observed; no internal claims are made.
KD pairs are sequence-level text only (GLM->Qwen cross-family); no vocabulary, logit or hidden-state alignment is assumed or performed.
The KD set is mechanism-scale; a null or negative held-out delta would be a real result, not a failure to hide.

dataset_v2.training_composition: six v1 training cases (byte-identical rows) plus sixteen newly authored cases

distill.compatibility_note: cross-family (GLM->Qwen) pairs carry text only; no vocabulary, logit or hidden-state alignment is assumed or performed
distill.composition: six receipted v1 training pairs (reused; their traces were judged in the v1 pilot) plus E2 positives from the newly judged traces

teacher_e2_new_judged.authored_denominator: the graded total per case is the frozen authored oracle count; unjudged checks (candidate errors) count as FAILED
teacher_e2_new_judged.extraction_rule: last fenced ```python block; whole response if it is itself a def-containing source; else no_code_block failure
teacher_e2_new_judged.note: these are the SIXTEEN NEW training cases only; the v1 pilot's receipted teacher numbers on the frozen 16 non-final evaluation cases stand unchanged and are not re-measured here

runtime_versions.note: authored and judged on Windows Python; oracle grading ran in WSL2 Ubuntu (Linux sandbox required by the host oracle)

student.e2_student: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (local HF cache, GPU LoRA receiver; the v1 pilot used the 0.5B Instruct student)

teacher.remote_consent: --allow-remote passed for the E2 trace run only; per-run consent, never carried over
teacher.traced_cases: 16 new E2 training cases (v1's 16 non-final traces stay receipted in the v1 pilot; the final split was never traced in either experiment)
